$comment: Bank-approved copy (demo). Conventional templates are seeded as 'approved'; Islamic as 'sharia_approved'. Syntax: {fact}, [[fact: shown when fact is non-zero]], [[!fact: shown when fact is zero]]. Doha Demo Bank is fictional. 'generic' entries carry no customer data and are served when no consent is on record (non-negotiable 5). 'factLabels' label the fact chips; 'explanations' word the 'Why am I seeing this?' reasons. Labels and explanations are shared by both variants, so they use variant-neutral terms.

templates.headline: This account becomes dormant on {dormancyDate}, in {daysUntilDormancy} days
templates.body: Your last activity on this account was on {lastActivityDate}. Accounts with no activity for {dormancyPeriodDays} days become dormant and are restricted until reactivated. Any transaction you make, such as a transfer or a deposit, keeps it active. Your balance of {currentBalance} stays yours either way.

templates.headline: Keeping your accounts active
templates.body: Accounts with no activity for a long period become dormant and are restricted until reactivated. Any transaction you make keeps an account active. You can see your accounts in the app, or ask us.

templates.headline: إبقاء حساباتك نشطة
templates.body: الحسابات التي لا يُجرى عليها نشاط لفترة طويلة تصبح خاملة وتُقيَّد حتى إعادة تفعيلها. أي معاملة تجريها تبقي الحساب نشطاً. يمكنك الاطلاع على حساباتك في التطبيق أو سؤالنا.
